summary: Tested the 4pt gold bars, the copyright footer and the Verse Choice Panel (admin) on the backend and frontend. Backend: 13 of 14 pytest tests passed. The one failure is minor: verses made of only spaces are accepted. Frontend: every requested flow passed. Header bottom border and scripture banner top/bottom borders all compute to the same value (5px solid rgb(212,175,55); 4pt rounds to 5px). The footer shows '© 2026 The Lord's Gym. All rights reserved.' on the welcome, login and dashboard pages and stays at the bottom of the window on short pages (tested with a 2600px-tall window). The welcome banner loads its verses from the API and changes every 7s. Admin flow passed: edit, move up/down, delete, add, the error toast when text is empty (nothing saved), and the 'Scripture banner updated' toast on save. Changes persist after reload and the welcome banner shows the edited verse. Member flow passed: no admin-tools on the dashboard, /admin/verses redirects to /dashboard, PUT gives 403 (401 when logged out).

minor.issue: Verse text/ref made of only spaces ('   ') returns 200 and is saved. Pydantic min_length=1 does not strip whitespace. The frontend trims and blocks this, but the API does not.

issues: Footer content uses max-w-7xl but the header/dashboard containers are narrower, so the copyright text starts a little left of the header logo. Small alignment mismatch.

action_items: Optional: add whitespace stripping/validation to VerseIn (e.g. StringConstraints(strip_whitespace=True, min_length=1)) so blank verses are rejected server-side
Optional: AdminVerses useEffect api.get('/verses') has no catch, so a failed request leaves the loader spinning forever; add error handling
Optional: align footer container width with header container
critical_code_review_comments: AdminVerses fetch has no error state (infinite Loader on failure)
VerseRow uses the array index as React key; fine for controlled inputs, but focus may jump during reorders

success_rate.backend: 93% (13/14, only failure is minor whitespace validation)
